AD: Seoyoung (Elly) Kong and Anna Sink

With the current state of the world, where more people live farther apart yet are connected by technology, we sometimes forget about those who really matter. However, even if we remember to call, especially our parents, what do we even talk about? Give yourself a reason to call by gamifying the connection. (Yes, it’s true, we made the integration.)
AD: Seoyoung (Elly) Kong and Rasa Ghaffaripour
Whether we intend to or not, taking on any endurance sport will oftentimes leave us working hard alone. Working out will always be difficult, but having a community to fall back on makes it easier.
AD: Seoyoung (Elly) Kong, Grace Xu, and Laila Dieye | CW: Jessica Mansur

Owning a cat introduces a kind of psychological chaos, where their unpredictable behavior makes owners overanalyze, question everything, and ultimately change their own behavior to keep the peace. So we reframed cat ownership for what it really feels like: a one-sided, slightly toxic relationship. But maybe it’s all in your head?
AD: Seoyoung (Elly) Kong | CW: Siddhaarth Mayekar

Sometimes you need a break, a break from everything, a break to hide away from the rest of the world, where no one will find you. The Great Basin National Park is tucked away where no one visits. Lose yourself amongst the caves, trees, and stars.
AD: Seoyoung (Elly) Kong and Hailey Flemons

Growing families lead transitional and optimized lives, wanting to invest in their future. Lovesac’s Sactionals are rearrangeable, easily fixable, and long-lasting, and those considering buying one usually have a Roomba. By targeting these affluent families with big homes that need cleaning and rearranging, The Spatialist helps you reorganize your space with the optimal Feng Shui flow for whatever part of life fits their needs.
AD: Seoyoung (Elly) Kong | CW: Amanda (Mandy) Sierra

Sometimes, it feels like nothing ever goes your way. But with the Ninja Crispi, your meals never miss a beat. Food should be reliable, the certainty you can count on when nothing else seems to go as planned. Because some days, it’s not about getting everything right, but knowing at least one thing will be.

We feel like we don’t have time anymore to even respond to friends or learn something new. Just like how you have time to have thoughts under the shower, you can also have potty breaks. You can utilize the time you didn’t realize you always had.

blocks.html:
My name is Seoyoung or Elly, and I love anything art.

I’m a senior Texas Creative advertising major with a studio art minor, media studies film minor, and a creative writing certificate at the University of Texas at Austin.

Currently, I am a junior art director intern and production assistant at the Two Shot West agency. I love working with other creatives to help create PSAs, independent films, and other Ads.

When I’m not with my partners creating mock-ups, I’m selling art trinkets at Austin fairs, drawing, writing, or finally getting to photoshopping hundreds of my photos from trips to Korea.

To know more about me, ask about the time I met David Tennant, cried with joy 5 times, and gave him a custom-painted and sewn necktie, clay necktie clips, and a letter.
AD/Editor: Seoyoung (Elly) Kong | CW: Johnny Moreno-Cedillo
